items.summary: src/game.ts: the Race record has a new field, `view: RaceView | null`, documented in one comment line. It starts as null in startRace, tick() sets it back to null after carViews, and draw() uses `const view = (r.view ??= raceView(r.world))`. So raceView now runs at most once per sim tick instead of on every animation frame. The driver's state() call to raceView is unchanged. Net +4 lines.

The button type and transition block (font-family, size, weight, style, line-height, text-transform, transition) now lives in one grouped `.ui-button, .ui-tc` rule in components.css, right after .ui-button. cursor stays on .ui-button. Those declarations are deleted from .ui-tc in touch-controls.css, and its comment is shortened to point at components.css; the BRAKE off-scale note is kept. No other stylesheet targets .ui-tc, and components.css loads before touch-controls.css. P1 DOM and computed styles match the original tree.

hud.css: padding, border-top: 0, border-radius and line-height for both chips are now in one grouped `.ui-hud-best, .ui-hud-new-best` rule at the .ui-hud-best position. display/align-items/gap stay on .ui-hud-best, and visibility/transform stay on .ui-hud-new-best.

Each split rule is folded into the first rule for its selector. In hud.css: timer `isolation: isolate` moves into the first .ui-hud__timer rule, best's `position: relative; z-index: 1` into the single-selector .ui-hud-best rule, and `display: block` into the first .ui-hud-pos__n rule; the second rules are deleted. In title.css, the second .ui-track-card:focus-visible rule (transform, box-shadow) is merged into the first. The comment above the NEW BEST block is kept.

Comment-only changes. components.css: '(start title, results track name)', '(LAP, TIME, results rows)' and 'Big overlay (pause card, countdown roundel)'. The screens.css header now reads 'Pause card, the triple stripe and the full-screen menu ground (results). Tokens only.'

The results.css header comment now says the navy ground is in screens.css and that rows and the roundel use .ui-value type. The screens.css header was rewritten once, together with C035, and mentions the results ground.

Removed only the `export` keyword from DESKTOP_MIN and DESKTOP_QUERY (layout.ts), outlinePath (track-card.ts), SCREEN_CHANGE_MS (screen-change.ts), KEY_MAP, ACTION_KEY and PAUSE_KEY (keyboard.ts), and PAD_BUTTON, STICK_DEAD_ZONE and stickSteer (gamepad.ts). Before the change I grepped the repo again (node_modules, journal and spikes excluded) and found each name only in its own file.
Docs only. The src/ui/types.ts header now says the view models are built by race-ui.ts (and by the game, for track cards) from sim views, and that the UI never reads the World.

structured_output.claudeMd: In 'How the game fits together', the line saying the UI receives view models from `src/ui/types.ts` was wrong. It now says the UI receives the sim's view types (`RaceView`, `CarView` from `src/sim/types.ts`), never the World, and that race-ui builds its own view models (`src/ui/types.ts`) from them (C053). Nothing else changed.
